description: Connectivity fell nationwide within minutes of strikes on central Tehran. Starlink terminals were jammed and hundreds of suspected users detained. The blackout also made casualty figures and specific events difficult to verify from outside.
source_name: Al Jazeera; Fox News citing Israeli officials

aspect: Not knowing is worse than bad news, measurably
description: Uncertainty about whether a specific person is alive produces a stress response that does not habituate, because there is no information to adapt to. Confirmed bad news at least permits grief to start.
energy_note: The one state the mind cannot settle into.

description: Refreshing a feed that does not update, re-sending a message that will not deliver, waiting for a check-in that does not come. Clinicians describe nocturnal monitoring of events as a defining diaspora symptom.
energy_note: A full-time job with no output.

aspect: Rumour fills the vacuum and is taken seriously
description: With no verifiable information, people act on the best available story. Families evacuate, spend money, and separate on the basis of a message forwarded six times.
energy_note: Life decisions made from a forwarded voice note.

description: Last message: 'we're fine, going to my aunt's'. Sent Tuesday 19:12. It is now Sunday. He has read it about four hundred times and it says the same thing every time.
energy_note: Five days inside a single sentence.

aspect: Afterwards, the person does not trust information at all
description: Having lived through a period where official statements, rumour and silence were equally unreliable, the person applies that scepticism permanently - to doctors, employers and institutions in a country where it is unwarranted.
energy_note: Immune to being told the truth.
